act_info.act_name: Mid-Tier Booster Auto Rebate -  Weekdays Jan

textContent.value: Join us for our Mid-Tier Booster Auto Rebate -  Weekdays, meet other hosts, and get yourself rewarded.⚡
⏰ Event run time: 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM PST.

lv.1 - if 1,000 beans received, get 550 beans reward
lv.2 - if 2,500 beans received, get extra 850 beans reward
lv.3 - if 5,000 beans received, get extra 850 beans reward

The maximum reward you can receive is 2,250 beans reward

Go live in Solo Live Room at least 20 mins within the hour, you can do all event formats you like!

buttons.name: Join Family Event to Win Host Gala Tickets

level_config.process_notice_lang: You've reached Lv.1! Receive 1,500 more beans to unlock more rewards.
You've reached Lv.2! Receive 2500 more beans to unlock more rewards.
You've reached Lv.3! Receive 3000 more beans to unlock more rewards.

textContent.value: -We will conduct an audit on Overseas beans (beans received outside of the US/CA region); if the proportion of Overseas beans exceeds 20% of the total beans received, no rewards will be issued 🌍
-Go live for at least 20 mins is required 🕘
- Please do not choose the same time as your other Power Rebate events, otherwise we will only launch the higher reward 🔝
